resource: Creature actors of one Channel, every kind (replaces AI01-ACTIVE-ACTORS 256 for creatures)
allocation_impact: Checked in ChannelActorCarrier::admit_creature against the carrier's occupied-slot count before any slot is selected or written, and in the respawn drive's admission (respawn_into_free_cell) after the dead creature has left; it reserves nothing. The count includes every actor, so it is conservative: the 131,072-slot pre-production carrier never reaches it. The creature ledgers are bounded by the same value: the melee owner is keyed by carrier slot (one live generation per slot; a newer generation replaces a stale entry in place), and the creature bite ledger is keyed by the issuer's exact generation and drops dead issuers' entries when full, so a live issuer is never refused. Native summon and masterless encounter admission (admit_native_summon, admit_native_encounter_masterless) check the same occupied count before anything is written, in place of the D57 envelope of 64 live creatures (Codex 4242954089); the native summon links, one per child actor, are bounded by the same value and indexed by child and parent (Codex 4243039217), and retire_native_summons retires dead children however many there are, examining at most SPAWNCEIL-RL-02 links per call; a summon admission first retires its own parent's dead children.
boundary_tests: max=262144: a carrier of 262,145 slots admits 262,144 creatures
max+1=262145: the next creature is refused CAPACITY_EXCEEDED with nothing written, and the free slot still admits a player
consumers: apps/game-server/src/foundation/runtime_actor_carrier.rs ChannelRuntimeV1::admit_native_summon, admit_native_encounter_masterless and retire_native_summons (no 64-creature or 64-dead-child refusal)
apps/game-server/src/ability/creature_bite.rs CREATURE_BITE_LEDGER_MAX: CreatureBiteLedger (keyed by exact issuer generation, dead entries dropped when full)
apps/game-server/src/ai_monster_melee.rs MonsterMeleeOwner (keyed by carrier slot, capped by CREATURE_BITE_LEDGER_MAX)
apps/game-server/src/ai_think/channel_owner.rs CreatureAiTable::forget_dead (the think table holds live creatures only)
